title: Analysis code for "A support-cell secretome program in human hippocampal aging is directionally reproducible but not gene-specific"

creators.name: Shimozaki, Koji
creators.affiliation: Brain Science Research Unit, Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences, Nagasaki University, Nagasaki, Japan

description:
Pre-specified reanalysis of public human hippocampal single-nucleus multiome data through a 2,224-gene secretome lens, with donors as the unit of replication.

The repository contains the analysis pipeline, the pre-specified analysis documents, the audit trail (audit_log/), pinned conda environments (envs/), and the committed result tables that underlie every number reported in the manuscript. Figure, validation, supplementary-table and multiple-testing-scope targets run from a bare clone using the committed tables alone; targets that recompute chromatin-accessibility concordance, differential-expression robustness, the regulatory layer and the primary differential-expression table additionally require the deposited matrices, which are not redistributed here. Known limits of reproducibility are stated in the manuscript Methods and in results/audit_reruns/calibration/README.md.

Primary data are public: GSE268609, GSE278576, GSE299139, GSE186538, GSE199243, GSE264692, GSE325391.
